articles.title: Sources: Kelce expected to return to Chiefs
articles.summary: Tight end Travis Kelce, a three-time champion with the Chiefs, is expected to return for his 14th season with the team, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Sources: Falcons eye Tua after Dolphins cut QB
articles.summary: The Falcons are expected to pursue Tua Tagovailoa in free agency, sources told ESPN, after the QB was informed that he will be released by the Dolphins.

articles.title: Sources: Dolphins trade DB Fitzpatrick to Jets
articles.summary: The Dolphins are sending Minkah Fitzpatrick to the Jets in exchange for the 2026 seventh-round pick from the Chargers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Packers trading DL Gary to Cowboys
articles.summary: The Green Bay Packers are finalizing a deal that would send defensive lineman Rashan Gary to the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 draft pick, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter. The pick is a fourth-rounder, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Sources: NFL labor talks with refs hit rough patch
articles.summary: The NFL's negotiations with the NFL Referees Association on a new collective bargaining agreement are not in a good place, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Rams reach record deal with McDuffie
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams and All-Pro cornerback Trent McDuffie reached agreement on a record four-year, $124 million extension that includes $100 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday night.

articles.title: Raiders trading for Bills CB Johnson, source says
articles.summary: The Raiders are sending a sixth-round pick to the Bills in exchange for veteran cornerback Taron Johnson and a seventh-round selection, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Texans to bring back Ingram, Rankins
articles.summary: Guard Ed Ingram and defensive tackle Sheldon Rankins will not hit free agency after agreeing to multiyear deals with the Texans, according to ESPN and NFL Network.
